arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  m."XCL_035",
  m."XCL_036",
  m."XCL_040"
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m."XCL_034" = e."XCL_022"
JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
JOIN event AS ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
WHERE m."XCL_038" <> 'Member'
  AND e."XCL_021" = 'true'
  AND SUBSTR(ev."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'
  AND e."XCL_020" > (
    SELECT AVG(e2."XCL_020")
    FROM expense AS e2
    JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2."XCL_023" = b2."XCL_003"
    JOIN event AS ev2 ON b2."XCL_009" = ev2."XCL_010"
    WHERE e2."XCL_021" = 'true'
      AND SUBSTR(ev2."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'
  )

    m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name,
    m.XCL_037 AS phone_number
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_038 <> 'Member'
  AND e.XCL_021 = 'Approved'
  AND strftime('%m', ev.XCL_012) = '09'
  AND e.XCL_020 > (
      SELECT AVG(e2.XCL_020)
      FROM expense e2
      JOIN budget b2 ON e2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
      JOIN event ev2 ON b2.XCL_009 = ev2.XCL_010
      WHERE e2.XCL_021 = 'Approved'
        AND strftime('%m', ev2.XCL_012) = '09'
  )
